_comment: Known-and-accepted advisories. CI fails on anything NOT listed here, so this file is the repo's dependency-debt ledger, not an ignore-list to grow casually. Every entry is an advisory id and the reason it is accepted. The gate fails on an entry with no reason, and on an entry whose advisory is gone, until it is pruned (#821): a stale entry is still an exemption for that id if a downgrade brings the advisory back. Started at 91 entries (#342); one remains (braces), with no fixed version to move to; sprintf-js was pruned 2026-10-22 when jest's coverage chain stopped pulling it. Regenerate with: python scripts/audit_gate.py --pip-audit <json> --npm-audit <json> --baseline security-baseline.json --write-baseline, which keeps the reasons already written and leaves a new entry's reason empty for a person to fill in.

npm.GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm: braces 3.0.3 (no patched version, all <=3.0.3 affected); build-time only via @tailwindcss/cli > @parcel/watcher > micromatch, globs are repo-controlled, not user input. Prune when braces ships a fix.
